# CamelGraph v0.50.0: a new logo, a floating node library and a clearer Script Player (personal-use edition with installer)

> **Personal use only.** This download (GitHub, bimcamel.com) is the free *Personal use* edition under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0: learning, hobby projects, research, and charities, schools, universities, public research bodies and government institutions. **For professional use** (work at a company, a consultancy or design office, a paid project or product) a copy for the **Autodesk App Store** is **coming soon**; it will come with a commercial licence from BIMCamel. It is the same program in both editions.

## What is new since 0.49.0

* **A new logo.** The mark is the wire that climbs into a hump before it drops into the right-hand socket, between two node ends. The dark icon (installer, Windows Apps, Autodesk App Store) is a wash from deep blue to near-black instead of flat black. In the editor the mark still follows the theme: light on the dark palettes, dark on the Light one.
* **The name in pixel letters.** "CamelGraph" is drawn in the pixel letters of the BIMCamel wordmark on bimcamel.com, in the editor header and start screen, the About window and the installer.
* **A new Script Player icon.** A play triangle made of two wires that pass over and under a third, in the ribbon (black and white, like the CamelGraph button) and in the Script Player's header.
* **The node library floats.** It is a rounded card on the canvas, with a search box across its full width and round buttons to expand and collapse all categories. A **HIDE** tab on its edge hides it; a **NODES** tab on the edge of the canvas brings it back. Hiding it from the View menu or the command palette works as before.
* **The Script Player looks like a tool panel.** A header with its icon, cards for the script, the inputs and the results, and a footer with a wide **Run** button and three square buttons (reset, open in the editor, show in Explorer). The script folders open from the folder button in the header.
* **Inputs, results and text boxes no longer look alike in the Script Player.** Every label is bold; each input has a small tag for its kind of control (TEXT, NUMBER, CHOICE, COLOUR, FILE OR FOLDER, SELECTION; the on/off switch needs none); a number's name is above its field like every other field's. A result is a card with a green bar and an OUTPUT tag (red with ERROR when the node failed), and its value is in a monospace face with no box around it, so it cannot be mistaken for something you can type in.
* **Run moves to the right edge of the editor header.** It is a flat button as tall as the header. Just left of it is the Auto / Manual switch, then a separator, then undo, redo, previews, minimap and settings.


Questions and problems: support@bimcamel.com, or the issue form on GitHub. The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.

Only Navisworks Manage 2024 has been seen running CamelGraph in the field; 2025, 2026 and Simulate are built and installed the same way but not yet confirmed. **Help > Run Self-Test** checks the nodes against your own model.
